name: indian_visa
title: Indian eVisa Form Walkthrough
description: Fill the Indian eVisa application start form with safe dummy data and stop before captcha submission.
prompt: Open indianvisaonline.gov.in eVisa form, enter fake applicant details, and stop safely at captcha.
narration_script_text:
Welcome, traveler. Destination India. First boss: the eVisa portal. Open the official page.

Scroll down and click Apply here for e-visa. The speedrun starts now.

Build the character: nationality USA, passport ordinary. Unless you're a secret agent, this is the lane. Then choose your port of arrival.

And now, Digital Dharma. While the servers search for inner peace, check your sunscreen, practice your namaste, maybe hydrate.

Still loading? Of course it is. Government loading bars only move after enlightenment. Stay with me. The servers have spoken.

Date of birth, then email. Use one you actually know the password for.

Choose e-Tourist Visa, 30 Days, the classic mode. Set your arrival date, then check the instruction box like a very lawful menace.

Stop at the captcha. India is waiting.
